notes: Sweeney is printed 'SWEENEY (WEBB)' (20 ft), suffix added as on sheets 7 and 9. Sweeney's NE corner block at Smith is not drawn here (it is on sheet 11, where Sweeney continues east), so Smith/Sweeney is a cross. Smith narrows about 40 px on its west side north of W. 4th (NW corner x 3683, SW corner x 3643; east side about x 3854); the pick averages the corners. W. 3rd widens from about 50 ft at Rose to 66 ft at Smith (south line drops); picks are local centres. Rose runs from W. 3rd to W. 2nd as one straight line; between about y 2610 and y 3800 it crosses the Big 4 / B.&O.S.W. yard as a dashed (paper) street with spur tracks ending at bumpers on its east side. Halpin Alley (printed 'HALPIN ALLEY', no width) runs between the rear of the W. 3rd lots and the yard tracks from the east wall of the American Express Co. building to the dashed line of the C.&O. bridge carriage & foot approach, west of Smith; it reaches neither Rose nor Smith. The vertical '66' near Smith at y~4120 is taken as the W. 2nd width. Smith pipe runs about 10-30 px west of Smith's centreline; picks use block corners, not pipes.
